summary: Meta's llama-models GitHub repository added support for Llama 4 in its v0.2.0 release.

practices.reason: The repo now supports a new model family, which would require updating client code to use it, but no details on API changes are given.

notable_reason: Signals the arrival of Llama 4, a new frontier model family from Meta, even though this release note itself carries no technical detail.
